mapper.insert: INSERT INTO supplier_score_main (supplier_id, score_period, total_score, supplier_level, score_user, score_time, opinion, create_time) VALUES (#{supplierId}, #{scorePeriod}, #{totalScore}, #{supplierLevel}, #{scoreUser}, #{scoreTime}, #{opinion, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW())

INSERT INTO supplier_score_item (main_id, supplier_id, score_type, full_score, actual_score, remark, create_time) VALUES
(#{i.mainId}, #{i.supplierId}, #{i.scoreType}, #{i.fullScore}, #{i.actualScore}, #{i.remark, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT i.score_type, CASE i.score_type WHEN 1 THEN '产品质量' WHEN 2 THEN '交付能力' WHEN 3 THEN '价格成本' WHEN 4 THEN '资质合规' WHEN 5 THEN '售后服务' WHEN 6 THEN '合作稳定' ELSE '未知' END AS score_type_name, i.full_score, i.actual_score, i.remark FROM supplier_score_item i WHERE i.main_id = #{mainId} ORDER BY i.score_type ASC
mapper.sql: m.main_id, m.supplier_id, s.supplier_name, m.score_period, m.total_score, m.supplier_level, m.score_user, m.score_time, m.opinion, m.create_time
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM supplier_score_main m LEFT JOIN supplier_info s ON m.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
ORDER BY m.create_time DESC
